_meta.purpose: deck artifact: deck.authored.json built via slides_generate + edited via deck_patch, using a deck_stage starter (GAP kit) and image media-slots. Files delivery mode, deck_export pipeline (no preflight stage).

manifest.starter_kit_note: registry registers no starter_kit for deck today; this fixture references the proposed deck_stage kit (GAP) for the on-canvas stage. deck_stage is NOT in kits/starter.py yet.

semantic_metadata.note: Deck slides carry data-disco-* anchors for media-slot identity and per-slide section/version, so deck_patch can target a specific slot. Image slots start as placeholders until resolved.

tweak_metadata.note: deck kind has no registered TweakSpec; decks are edited via deck_patch, not tweaks. Empty by design.

evidence_host_must_observe: deck.authored.json exists and parses as the authored deck model
each slide has resolvable content; media-slots either resolve to embedded image bytes or are flagged as placeholders
deck renders to slides without authoring-model errors

expected_output.artifact: PPTX/HTML deck export with image bytes embedded (not [image] placeholders)

export_expectations.note: deck_export has NO preflight stage (bundle, validate, deliver only) — matches registry.

known_invalid_variants.name: missing_authored_json
known_invalid_variants.mutation: deck.authored.json absent (e.g. only an exported PPTX present)
known_invalid_variants.expected_failure: ready_for_deck_verification rejects: required file deck.authored.json missing

known_invalid_variants.name: unembedded_image_slot
known_invalid_variants.mutation: deck_export run while slide-1.hero_image is still a placeholder, producing an [image] placeholder in the PPTX
known_invalid_variants.expected_failure: deck_export validate stage rejects / verification flags: media-slot bytes not embedded (regression C7 guard)

known_invalid_variants.name: preflight_stage_injected
known_invalid_variants.mutation: export config declares a preflight stage for deck_export
known_invalid_variants.expected_failure: ExportContract for deck_export rejects: pipeline must be (bundle, validate, deliver) with no preflight
